_comment: NFR-P1 performance budget for the admin workspace shell (TP1-07, P1-12). check-lighthouse.mjs runs Lighthouse against each page and fails if the budget is breached. NFR-P1 IS the LCP budget: the shell loads and is interactive in 2.5s or less on a mid-range laptop on broadband, so the hard budget is desktop form factor, LCP <= 2500ms (observed ~763ms in CI, ~912ms locally). tbtMs and perfScore are SECONDARY guards against a gross interactivity regression, not the NFR. Total Blocking Time is single-threaded and runs much higher and noisier on a shared 2-vCPU CI runner than on a dev laptop (local ~16ms, CI ~311ms), so tbtMs carries ~2x headroom (600ms) to catch a real doubling of blocking time without flaking on runner jitter; tighten it when the measurement target moves to real admin screens. The shell demo is gated off in a normal prod build, so build + start with NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_GALLERY=1 before running.
